text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.23 for the Senior Full Stack Software Developer position. The strongest evidence of their technical capability is that they have "Built REST APIs" and listed experience with Node.js, React, SQL, Docker, and AWS. Key gaps include a lack of experience with ruby, git, and ci/cd, as well as having only 2.5 years of experience compared to the requirement. The application has been escalated for manual review despite the low fit and missing must-have requirements.
